# GLM Models for GitHub Copilot Chat

> A VS Code extension for using GLM models in GitHub Copilot Chat with your own API key.
> Supports image input, agent mode, tool calling, and streamed thinking.

Published as `yijiazhen-qi.glm-for-github-copilot-chat` under the MIT license. Requires VS Code
1.127 or later. The extension implements `vscode.LanguageModelChatProvider` and streams
OpenAI-compatible SSE from the GLM API. It uses the VS Code API and Node.js built-ins, with
no runtime dependencies.

Coding Plan and Standard API are available in the International (`z.ai`) and Mainland China
(`bigmodel.cn`) regions. GLM-5.3 is Coding Plan only. Flash is available on both API modes;
FlashX is Standard API only. GLM-5.2 and earlier are available through `glm-copilot.showLegacyModels`.

For new Chat and Copilot CLI conversations, the extension recommends GLM-5.3 on Coding Plan
and GLM-5.3-Flash on Standard API. Explicit user and organization defaults take precedence.
Existing conversations keep their selected model.

GLM-5.3 and both Flash models have 1M-token context windows and require thinking. Low, High,
and Max effort are available, with Max as the default. Flash and FlashX receive images
directly. Text-only models receive a Flash description as untrusted visual context. Both
requests use the configured endpoint and chat key.

`GLM: Set API Key` stores the key in VS Code `SecretStorage` (the OS keychain). A settings
fallback exists for CI and automation. Keep real keys out of workspace settings.
